units.rawText: After organizing the information I've collected since entering the village and the reminder from the boy, I've already decided on my first stop for clarifying the truth of those stories—the town hall!

units.rawText: Most of the obstacles in my way have been removed, except for a certain albatross around my neck that has been particularly difficult to shed.

units.rawText: Don't think I can't tell that you're badmouthing me.
units.displayText: Don't think I can't tell that you're badmouthing me.

spans.text: Don't think I can't tell that you're badmouthing me.

units.rawText: Of course, the badmouthing would have gone to waste if you hadn't picked up on it.
